## Selected microlabs

- [pilot microlabs](snapshots/pilot/assets/labs/index.html)
- [pre-group-review microlabs](snapshots/pre-group-review/assets/labs/index.html)
- [final microlabs](snapshots/final/assets/labs/index.html)

The three stage indexes link to the local hash playground, Merkle-tree activity, and encryption/signature activity. The explorer compares distinct Merkle-tree and encryption/signature versions; repeated stages share a preview. All activity links use this website’s origin.

## Highlighted microlabs

- [Proof-of-work coin mining](index.html?microlab=coin-flip): race simulated miners and explore block production and difficulty adjustment.
- [Smart-contract execution](index.html?microlab=smart-contract): inspect contract calls, state changes, and a reentrancy attack.
- [MEV, builders, and relays](index.html?microlab=mev): order transactions, compare builder bids, and choose a proposer policy.

Each activity opens its distinct pilot and final versions side by side. The timeline identifies the pre-group-review copy shared with the pilot; source views and single-preview layouts are also available.
